messages:
oncall-bot: PAGER: [P1] model-serving-gpu-01 OOM during inference. ~95% error rate for /v1/generate in us-west-2. Paging: @alex @jordan
alex: seeing it. digging now.
jordan: i'm on standby, switching traffic to fallback model, initiating graceful drain.
alex: running `top` + `journalctl -u inference.service` — looks like memory growth after the 03:14 deploy.
alex: rollback? deploy tag: release-5.2.3
jordan: initiating rollback now: `/scripts/rollback.sh release-5.2.2 --region us-west-2` (running)
oncall-bot: Deploy-bot: rollback started by @jordan (run id 4829)
emily_eng: @alex @jordan do we have an estimated mitigation window?
alex: rollback in progress, 2 nodes done, 4 to go. expected 8-12m.
sre_lead: pinging infra to spin new instances if needed. @ops-bot start-autoheal us-west-2 inference-pool
ops-bot: Autoheal triggered for inference-pool in us-west-2 — requested 3 replacements.
jordan: rollback complete on 6/6 nodes. error rate dropping to ~2%.
cs_lead: customer impact check: Zendesk shows 12 customer-reported errors, ~5 support tickets created. Any customers on live SLAs?
sam_pm: please post to status.redwood.ai: "Degraded performance for text generation in us-west-2; mitigation in progress"
alex: posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/1853002460
cs_lead: updating customers with the link + ETA for full recovery.
emily_eng: can we confirm root cause — if it's the release we should call that out explicitly in the incident ticket.
alex: initial traces show mem growth in attention KV-cache after certain long prompts. capturing heap dump now: `/usr/local/bin/heapdump --pid 4281 --out /tmp/heap-4281.hprof`
jordan: collecting logs: `journalctl -u inference.service -S "2026-03-14 03:00" > /tmp/inference-journal.log`
emily_eng: great, please upload artifacts to the incident tracker (logs, heap dump, rollout history).
oncall-bot: Incident tracker: created INC-2026-314-01 by @alex link: https://tracker.redwood.ai/INC-2026-314-01
alex: temporary mitigation: enabled aggressive KV-cache eviction for us-west-2. patch applied: `config.kv.cache_eviction=aggressive`
sre_lead: also set circuit-breaker for long requests to 30s.
jordan: monitoring now — request error rate and latency are stabilizing. marking incident mitigated in PagerDuty.
oncall-bot: PagerDuty: Incident INC-2026-314-01 acknowledged by @jordan, mitigated by @alex, status: mitigated
cs_lead: let's schedule the postmortem. proposed sync: 2026-03-15 16:00 PDT (1 hour). who should attend?
sam_pm: that time works — include SRE, infra, eng-runtime, CS, and PM.
emily_eng: add QA and security to review heap dump handling.
alex: i'll draft the RCA: timeline, contributing factors, impact summary, mitigation steps, and action items.
jordan: i'll take the rollback playbook update as an action item.
sre_lead: i'll own infra auto-heal tuning and follow-up ticket.
emily_eng: deadline for draft: propose 2026-03-16 EOD.
alex: fine. @emily_eng @sam_pm please peer review by 2026-03-17 noon.
cs_lead: i'll prepare customer impact section and list of affected accounts.
oncall-bot: Reminder: postmortem calendar invite sent to attendees (@sam_pm, @emily_eng, @alex, @jordan, @sre_lead, @cs_lead) — link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/INC-2026-314-01-pm
emily_eng: draft uploaded to tracker: https://tracker.redwood.ai/INC-2026-314-01/rca-draft (please review)
alex: tagging reviewers: @emily_eng @sam_pm @sre_lead
sam_pm: quick note — Customers "BoltApp" and "NimbusCo" saw latency spikes but no data loss; include credit estimate if SLA threshold was crossed.
emily_eng: review comment: expand "root cause" to include kernel-level cache behavior and model kv-cache interaction. add clear reproduction steps.
alex: updated draft: added reproducer script + heap dump snippet: `/scripts/repro_mem_leak.sh --prompt-file examples/heavy_prompts.txt`
jordan: peer review: add more detail to rollback checklist — include `--force` flags and node drain order, and a verification step.
alex: ack, updated the rollback checklist.
devsec_bot: Security note: heap dump contains transient API keys and user email fragments — scrub before sharing externally.
alex: removing keys and re-uploading sanitized artifact now.
cs_lead: final review complete. just a few wording tweaks.
sre_lead: i sign off on the RCA pending action ticket creation.
alex: created follow-up tickets: TKT-2026-102 (kv-cache config audit), TKT-2026-103 (rollback playbook update), TKT-2026-104 (autoheal tuning)
alex: assigning owners: TKT-2026-102 -> emily_eng, TKT-2026-103 -> jordan, TKT-2026-104 -> sre_lead
sam_pm: thanks — final sign-off? can we mark RCA status: "Ready for exec review"
emily_eng: Approved. marking as Ready for exec review.
sre_lead: Approved.
cs_lead: Approved — i'll prepare the customer post-incident note for tomorrow morning.
alex: RCA sign-off: @emily_eng @sre_lead @cs_lead — signed off 2026-03-16 10:45 PT :white_check_mark:
oncall-bot: Incident tracker updated: RCA status = signed_off, follow-ups created: TKT-2026-102,TKT-2026-103,TKT-2026-104
jordan: closing thread — great work, team. :tada:
